## Episode Thesis

This is a Nordnet Pengepodden episode with former Norwegian national ice hockey player and TV 2 hockey expert Erik Follestad. It covers personal finance in sport: athletes have become more professional about saving, pensions and diversified funds, money is flowing into Norwegian sport through TV deals and football transfer fees, and professional sport is becoming more Americanised. No stocks are analysed and no investment recommendations are made. Listed companies come up only as sponsors, employers or platforms.
